card.name: Section numbers in label cross-references
card.fires_on: The leading section digit (mostly 2 or 6) right after an opening parenthesis in bracketed cross-references like "[see Dosage and Administration (2.1)]" or "[see Adverse Reactions (6.1)]".

modes.label: Dosage section 2
modes.description: The digit 2 in a cross-reference to Dosage and Administration subsections.

modes.label: Adverse reactions section 6
modes.description: The digit 6 in a cross-reference to Adverse Reactions subsections.

card.writes: The promoted and suppressed tokens look unrelated, so the output effect is unclear.
card.plain: It fires on the section number inside a "see Dosage and Administration (2.x)" style pointer in a drug label.
